accepted_scope: For every integer T>=3, a prefix-complete identity-containing family of exactly T permutations on 2T-3 labels with pairwise disjoint inversion sets; complete singleton-addition paths; maximum minority probability exactly 1/T; all constructed T>=4 families have no balanced pair and cannot be complete successful languages of symmetric binary pressing matrices.
boundary_T3: The seed has minority probability 1/3 on its variable pairs and is pressing-realizable.

public_edition.meaning: Original mathematical acceptance applies to the pinned original proof and audit. Independent review of this precise public editorial edition is an additional required gate.
